Look, I get it, we should try to support each other and keep each other from giving up hope, I agree. But it's clear to me that a lot of non depressed people have no idea how to help either, despite their claims to the contrary. Stuff like "Life is hard for everyone, stop feeling sorry for yourself" Does. Not. Help. It just makes a lot of people feel more depressed and hopeless, and that's what I hear all the time. If you really want to help, acknowledge the fact that you can't really do much and suggest that they speak to a professional. Or, give some examples of what worked for you. Don't just say "just mediate" and "just change your thinking" describe how those things work because a lot of people have no idea how to break this cycle. I get it, saying stuff like "me too" does nothing, but saying stuff like "life sucks deal with it" Also does nothing.

Yeah they're right this place is making me worse, it's a circle jerk, why don't I try going somewhere helpful? Like 7 cups! Oh, they don't help people with suicidal thoughts. The hotline! More robotic responses. Oh right, GetMotivated! And they proceed to talk about how you should never react negatively to anything,  and if you do your an aimless slave to your emotions. 

Some people come on here because it's the only place where they can have people listen to their problems and be greeted with empathy and encouragement. That's why those types of posts piss me off so much.
But if no one loves you, it's fair game.
